subject: Re: Pricing and committed-use options — Novaflow discovery follow-up
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Li <sophie.li@novaflow.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing and committed-use options — Novaflow discovery follow-up

Hi Sophie / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful to understand Novaflow's production plans for real-time reranking and semantic search. Per our discussion, a quick recap and next steps: 

Summary of what you shared:
- Primary workload: low-latency reranking + embeddings for retrieval + occasional long-form generation for summaries.
- Expected steady-state volume: ~3-4M inference requests/day. Average tokens per inference: ~300 (inference) + 100 (prompt) = ~400 tokens/request. => ~1.2–1.6B tokens/day, roughly 36–48B tokens/month (with spikes).
- Pilot timeline: PoC in May, production in Q3.
- Key asks: predictable unit economics ($/1M tokens), committed-use pricing, and startup program eligibility for first-year discounts.

Initial pricing frame (ballpark):
- List (no commit): $20 / 1M tokens (model variant: redwood-large-v1)
- 12‑month committed use (monthly billing): target range $6–8 / 1M tokens for a committed monthly volume >= 1B tokens/month (tiered).
- Multi-year (2+ year) / multi‑region commitments: additional 10% incentive on top of committed discount.
- Startup program: one-time 20% credit off billed usage for first 12 months (applies on top of early committed discount for qualifying startups).

Next steps I propose:
1) Can you confirm the monthly baseline you expect to commit to for a 12‑month term? (we typically size discounts to a committed monthly token baseline)
2) Are you eligible for a startup program (YC, early-stage investor list, or company < 24 months and <$5M revenue)? If so, I can route that for approvals.
3) I'll loop in Marissa (pricing) to draft a committed-use term sheet and a short SOW for the PoC.

I've attached an overview pricing sheet and a draft SOW stub for review.

Thanks — happy to jump on another 30m if it helps.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Li <sophie.li@novaflow.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novaflow.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing and committed-use options — Novaflow discovery follow-up

Thanks Ben — this is super helpful and aligned with what we talked about. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The 3–4M requests/day is our optimistic high-water. For planning we should size the commit around a 2M requests/day baseline to start (so ~800M tokens/day using your 400 tokens/request estimate) — ~= 24B tokens/month. We expect growth to 36–48B/month over 3–6 months if the PoC goes well.
- Our finance team is targeting a blended unit cost of <= $10 / 1M tokens at scale (post-discount) — that's our internal threshold to meet unit economics for this product line.
- We are a Series A (raised in 2026), revenue < $3M — does that make us eligible for the startup program?
- For the PoC in May we can commit to a short-term credit request (startup credits) and will be prepared to negotiate a 12-month commit by the end of PoC if performance and latency SLOs met.

Can you and Marissa share an example committed-use term sheet (monthly token commitment tiers, price per 1M tokens, overage rules, termination clauses)? Also interested in any multi‑year pricing incentives (we may consider a 2‑year commit if the numbers work).

Appreciate it — copying Tom who runs infrastructure.

Best,
Sophie
Sophie Li
Head of Product
Novaflow

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Li <sophie.li@novaflow.ai>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing and committed-use options — Novaflow discovery follow-up

Thanks Sophie — great, that helps a lot. Quick answers and what I'll do next: 

1) Startup eligibility: Series A, <$3M revenue => qualifies for our startup program. We'll route the 20% first‑year credit and a small PoC credit (TBD). I'll need a link to your cap table or lead investor confirmation (typical doc we ask for).

2) Target unit economics: your $10 / 1M tokens post-discount is reasonable. For reference, with a 12‑month committed commitment at ~24B tokens/month (~288B tokens/year) we can typically reach $6–7 / 1M tokens after committed discounts + startup credit for year 1. If you opt for a 24‑month commit of the same baseline we can move toward $5.4–6.3 / 1M (roughly 10% additional incentive).

3) Term sheet: I've asked Marissa to prepare a short committed-use term sheet that includes:
   - Monthly committed baseline tiers (e.g., 250M, 500M, 1B, 2B tokens/month)
   - Corresponding $/1M rates and overage banding (overage billed at 120% of the committed rate unless prepaid top-ups)
   - Credit application of startup program for first 12 months
   - Standard 30‑day termination with pro‑rata true-up on usage vs commit for the first 6 months, then 90‑day exit notice for year-long commitments

4) PoC / SLOs: we will provide 2 weeks of credits for the PoC and a performance checklist for latency SLOs (95p latency targets, traceability).

I'll ask Marissa to attach the term sheet and a formal pricing grid. Are you ok if we target a draft term sheet by EOD Monday (May 3)?

Thanks,
Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Li <sophie.li@novaflow.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing and committed-use options — Novaflow discovery follow-up

Hi Sophie —

Thanks for the detail and congrats on Series A. I've attached a draft committed‑use term sheet and an updated pricing grid (see attachments). High level notes from pricing: 

- Baseline tiers (monthly committed tokens):
  * 250M / month => $16 / 1M tokens
  * 500M / month => $12 / 1M tokens
  * 1B / month => $8 / 1M tokens
  * 2B+ / month => $6 / 1M tokens

- For Novaflow's stated starting commit (~800M tokens/day => note: Sophie clarified baseline ~24B/month; assuming you meant tokens/day earlier — we priced off monthly): based on your clarified baseline of ~24B/month, your committed band falls in the 2B+ / month tier which would be $6 / 1M.
- Startup program: eligible — we apply a 20% credit to billed usage for the first 12 months (applies after invoices are generated; we can apply as a credit on the account).
- Multi-year (24-month) incentive: additional 10% off committed rate => effectively $5.40 / 1M at the 2B+ tier.
- Overage and reconciliation: overage billed monthly at 120% of committed rate; quarterly reconciliation and option for true-up payments or invoice credits.
- SLA & termination: standard enterprise terms; will include performance SLOs in the SOW and a 30-day cure period for SLA misses.

Action items for Novaflow:
- Confirm the monthly baseline you want to commit to for 12 vs 24 months (we can create an annualized spend figure for legal and finance).
- Send cap table / investor confirmation for startup credits (redact sensitive details).
- Confirm if you'd like us to add a multi-region (EU) replica; that will change committed rate slightly for region egress (we can show that in the term sheet).

I'll attach the draft term sheet and a short SOW for the PoC (2‑week credit + performance checklist). Ben — please add the HubSpot deal link and we can move to a formal quote if Novaflow confirms the baseline.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Pricing & GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments:
- redwood_pricing_Q2_2027.pdf (pricing grid)
- SOW_novaflow_draft.docx (PoC scope)
